DitherGlobe.color: Colour of the land and the atmosphere.
DitherGlobe.accent: Colour of markers and arcs unless they set their own.
DitherGlobe.markers: Places to mark, each with lat, lon (degrees, north and east positive) and an optional color. Markers on the far side are hidden.
DitherGlobe.arcs: Lines lifted off the surface, each with from-lat, from-lon, to-lat, to-lon and an optional color.
DitherGlobe.speed: Degrees of rotation per second. Negative spins the other way.
DitherGlobe.start: The longitude facing the viewer at the start.
DitherGlobe.tilt: How far the north pole leans towards the viewer, in degrees.
DitherGlobe.light: Where the light comes from, in degrees clockwise from the top. 300 is the upper left.
DitherGlobe.ocean: Brightness of the sea on the lit side, 0 to 1.
DitherGlobe.atmosphere: A thin dithered glow around the lit rim.
DitherGlobe.draggable: Let people drag or use the arrow keys to turn the globe.
DitherGlobe.animated: Spin and pulse. false draws one still frame.
